title: Early Caucasian rug
notes: Early Caucasian rug. Transitional type, late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 10 August 1922. inv. no 732 from Cerablus (south-east Turkey). 171 x 304 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 38
